title: NFTMigrator.setInitialized is idempotent/not frozen; mappings remain editable
description: `setInitialized()` can be called repeatedly; `setMapping`/`setMappings` have no post-init freeze. Owner can change V1→V2 mappings after users begin migrating, changing what V2 NFTs future migrants receive for the same V1 tokens.
impact: Users migrating at different times can receive inconsistent V2 NFTs for the same underlying V1 entitlement. Trust-in-owner concern.
attack_path: Some users migrate, receiving V2 NFTs under mapping A.
Remaining users migrate and receive V2 NFTs under mapping B.
recommendation: Mark `initialized` as one-way and gate `setMapping`/`setMappings` on `!initialized`.
